section: Logitech through AVI-SPL: Rally Board 65 and Logitech workspace, education and government solutions
body:
AVI-SPL and Logitech work together on video collaboration, and Logitech technology is available through AVI-SPL. The page is a short guide to what Logitech offers, from personal workspaces to meeting rooms, and is useful when a customer is comparing device makers.

**What to know**

- **Positioning.** Logitech's video collaboration solutions are said to be used by over 70% of Fortune 500 companies, and their designs work with all leading video conferencing platforms. The range runs from personal workstations to enterprise-scale collaboration.
- **Rally Board 65.** An all-in-one collaboration device that combines audio and video with a 65-inch touchscreen display. The page describes it as very easy to deploy, as containing everything needed to add video quickly to meeting rooms and open spaces, as built for flexibility, and as making sure everyone in those spaces is seen and heard.
- **Team Workspace.** Wireless solutions for connectivity, with reliable and intuitive devices so teams can work from anywhere.
- **Personal Workspace.** Options for every workflow, from essential communication tools to ergonomic setups and advanced solutions.
- **Education Solutions.** Technology for learning environments intended to enhance accessibility, reduce distractions and foster collaboration.
- **Government Workspaces.** Video tools for government agencies described as secure, efficient and TAA/NDAA-compliant, aimed at remote collaboration, lower costs and better accessibility.
- **Mobile Workspace Solutions.** Business tools for employees who are traveling, onsite, working from home or in the office. The page says they are easy for IT to deploy and manage.
- **Accessories.** Items ranging from presenters and accessories for iPad to solutions for video conferencing.

**When to use this**

Use it when a customer asks whether AVI-SPL supplies Logitech, what the Rally Board 65 is, whether Logitech devices work with their video conferencing platform, or whether Logitech has TAA/NDAA-compliant options for government.

**Not stated in this source:** prices, technical specifications beyond the Rally Board 65 screen size, named platform certifications, and any other Logitech room device models.
